items.name: BMW Blue (Primary)
items.role: The single brand action color. All primary CTAs, "Learn More" link prefixes (blue text), nav-link active state. Press shifts to (#0653b6).

items.name: M Blue Light
items.role: + M Blue Dark (#1c69d4) + M Red (#e22718): The M tricolor stripe — appears on the corporate site only on M-model pages and the "M" badge. Never as CTA colors.

items.name: Canvas
items.role: The default page surface.

items.name: Surface Soft
items.role: Soft grey for the footer and sub-navigation bands.

items.name: Surface Card
items.role: The light plate behind a model card's photo block.

items.name: Surface Strong
items.role: A slightly heavier grey used as a section divider.

items.name: Surface Dark
items.role: Dark navy for hero bands and large dark CTAs. Not pure black — carries a warm undertone.

items.name: Surface Dark Elevated
items.role: One step lighter, used for nested cards on top of the dark hero.

items.name: Hairline
items.role: The 1px divider — input outline, configurator card outline, table separator.

items.name: Hairline Strong
items.role: A more visible 1px outline — disabled secondary buttons, emphasized table border.

items.name: Ink
items.role: All display and primary text. Not pure black — soft against photography.

items.name: Body
items.role: Default running text.

items.name: Body Strong
items.role: Emphasized paragraphs and lead text.

items.name: Muted
items.role: Footer links, breadcrumbs, captions.

items.name: Muted Soft
items.role: Disabled text, fine-print legal.

items.name: On Primary
items.role: White text on a blue button.

items.name: On Dark
items.role: White text on a dark hero band.

items.name: On Dark Soft
items.role: A slightly muted white for secondary text on dark bands.

items.name: Success
items.role: Confirmation messages and "available" indicators.

items.name: Warning
items.role: Warning callouts.

items.name: Error
items.role: Validation errors.
